profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer at Clover Network Inc.
profile.summary:
i’m a software engineer that enjoys the challenge of creating solutions that enable users to maximize their productivity through simple design and a streamlined user experience. Understanding a user’s desires and needs is integral to creating a solution that provides maximum value to users. I believe the most effective engineers account for the needs of the user and figure out how to get technology to solve those problems in the most efficient way.   I believe processes should be put in place to help productive people be productive, not to prevent nonproductive people from being nonproductive. This allows the most effective employees to be the most effective. 

Worked on all aspects of the development cycle including requirements validation, architecture, design, development, configuration management, installation and customer support.

   Worked in several server-side and client-side technologies including Swift (iOS & MacOS), Java & Kotlin (Android, ESB, SOAP and REST services, JavaFX), HTML/Javascript via React . Also worked with multiple storage technologies including RDBMS (PostgreSQL/GIS, Oracle, MySql), SOLR and MongoDB.

positions.title: Sr. Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Working as a software engineer developing ISV SDKs and Android applications, supporting Clover’s next generation, cloud-based POS systems built on Android. Responsible for developing and maintaining software development kits for multiple platforms including .NET, Android/Java, Javascript/Typescript and iOS/Swift to enable 3rd parties to integrate and leverage our payment enabled hardware and cloud-based software platform. Additional responsibilities include designing and developing platform SDK’s and extension points to enable 3rd party integrators to take advantage of Clover’s POS platform with minimal development effort. 

Responsibilities include finding and defining technical solutions to enable 3rd party integrators to minimize their time to market and development efforts by leveraging existing Clover platform capabilities.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Supporting multiple DoD projects and customers, including support for field engineers that provide direct customer support. In addition to software engineering tasks including system and product design, UI development (JavaFX, Swing, HTML/Javascript), data visualization, web service development (REST and SOAP) and data access (SQL, NoSQL), other responsibilities include customer support, development team lead, engineering lead for multiple projects, evaluating new and alternate technology and developing project estimates.

projects.title: myMVP
projects.description: An iOS application that allows the user to capture video highlights of a moment, after it  occurs, by constantly recording and throwing away video until the use wants to save a clip.
